scope: Bulgaria medical discovery — Medical University Plovdiv

verifiedFacts.claim: MU-Plovdiv publishes a 2026/27 English Medicine route: a master's-level Medicine degree with Biology, Chemistry and English-language entry assessment.
Its 2026/27 admission page lists exam dates from April through August, documents due from 2 March to 11 September 2026, a EUR 30 processing fee and EUR 270 entry-test fee per exam date.
MU-Plovdiv publishes EUR 10,000 annual tuition for newly admitted first-year English Medicine students in 2026/27.
Foreign secondary-school documents must be legalised, translated and certified under Bulgaria's relevant international treaties or general document-legalisation rules.

holdReasons: A full gold-standard medical profile needs independently verifiable programme/institution recognition badges. This batch did not establish the required 2–3 current third-party recognition records.

The admission page establishes entry testing and tuition, but not the complete programme-specific instructional/clinical structure, named teaching hospitals or practical-training arrangements needed for the decision content.
No current authoritative accommodation and student-living cost evidence bundle was completed.
nextAction: Verify the relevant Bulgarian accreditation/quality authority records and obtain current faculty evidence for the English Medicine clinical structure, teaching hospitals and international accommodation before packaging.
